oath.title: Scout Oath
lines: On my honor I will do my best
to do my duty to God and my country
and to obey the Scout Law;
to help other people at all times;
to keep myself physically strong,
mentally awake, and morally straight.

points.meaning: You stick with your family and your friends.
You help other people without being asked.
You are nice to everyone, even new kids.
You are polite and use good manners.
You are gentle and care about others.
You follow the rules at home and at school.
You stay happy, even when a job is hard.
You use things well and do not waste them.
You do what is right, even when you are scared.
You keep yourself and the world around you clean.
You respect your faith and what others believe.

cubMotto.title: Cub Scout Motto
lines: Do Your Best

bsaMotto.title: Scout Motto
lines: Be Prepared

bsaSlogan.title: Scout Slogan
lines: Do a Good Turn Daily

outdoorCode.title: Outdoor Code
lines: I will do my best to:
be clean and take my trash home;
be careful with fire;
be kind to people outside;
take care of nature.

leaveNoTrace.title: Leave No Trace for Kids
lines: Know before you go. Learn about the place first.
Choose the right path. Stay on the trail.
Trash your trash. Take your trash home.
Leave what you find. Rocks and flowers stay.
Be careful with fire. Never leave it alone.
Respect wildlife. Watch animals from far away.
Be kind to other people. Share the trail.
